contribution.concept: open intent discovery

problem.concept: online user comments, which often consist of arguments lacking proper substantiation and reasoning

task.concept: automatically classifying each proposition as UNVERIFIABLE, VERIFIABLE NONEXPERIENTIAL, or VERIFIABLE EXPERIENTIAL2

method.concept: additional features capturing the verifiability and experientiality

contribution.concept: framework for automatically classifying each proposition as UNVERIFIABLE, VERIFIABLE NONEXPERIENTIAL, or VERIFIABLE EXPERIENTIAL2
goldstandard dataset of 9,476 sentences and clauses from 1,047 comments submitted to an eRulemaking platform

problem.concept: there is no comprehensive study of network structure across a diverse set of domains in order to explain the structural diversity we observe in the real-world networks

task.concept: Characterizing the structural diversity of complex networks across domains

contribution.concept: Our results indicate that there are some partitions of network categories in which networks are hard to distinguish based purely on network structure

these partitions of network categories tend to have similar underlying functions, constraints and/or generative mechanisms of networks even though networks in the same partition have different origins, e.g., biological processes, results of engineering by human being, etc.
the origin of a network, whether it's biological, technological or social, may not necessarily be a decisive factor of the formation of similar network structure

problem.concept: most existing approaches rely on supervised machine learning (ML) and substantial labeled data that are expensive to develop and apply to different sub-fields of biomedicine

task.concept: information structure analysis of full scientific articles

contribution.concept: novel corpus of 50 biomedical articles annotated according to the Argumentative Zoning (AZ) scheme
